## Scope

A sample of 328 graded sets was read again by a second grader as part of the quality audit. The review considered whether the original grading decision was consistent when assessed independently. It was undertaken for the second quarter of 2021 and covered the selected graded sets included in the audit sample. The repeat reading provides a basis for reviewing grading consistency and identifying any matters that may require follow-up.

## Result

Overall agreement was 71.6 per cent. This result is reported for the audit sample as a whole and provides the summary measure of consistency between the original grading and the second reading. Per-grader results are available in the attached spreadsheet. These results are discussed with each grader privately, allowing individual performance and any questions arising from the review to be considered directly. The spreadsheet should be used alongside the private discussions when interpreting the audit findings.
